decisions.reason: Assigning Article 9 to the Business category does not change the required author identity, photo source, or placement after the category label.
The Article 9 category mapping does not alter the required shape or size of author photos.
The category assignment does not change when additional images should be requested or which elements may break up article text.
The Business category assigned to a different article does not affect the Dorian Vale article's color restriction or the reservation of red for the cover.
Identifying Article 9 and its category does not change the Civic Lantern website as the required source of article content.
The Article 9 category mapping does not modify the magazine's polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The category assignment does not change the required interactive PDF deliverable for the digital flipbook.
The Article 9 category mapping does not change the requirement to improve image quality with AI when necessary.
The Article 9 category assignment neither resumes nor changes the deferred print-ready output requirement.
